newsitem.title: FRANCE: Technip in China deal with Amoco.
newsitem.headline: Technip in China deal with Amoco.

text.p: French engineering group Technip said on Monday it had signed an agreement with the China Petrochemical International Co and Amoco Corp to build a gas-phase polypropylene production unit near Beijing.
Technip said in a statement it would supply engineering services, critical equipment and supervision, and Amoco would license its gas-phase technology. The terms were not disclosed.

"With a capacity of 200,000 metric tonnes per year, this plant will be the largest single train polypropylene plant ever built in China," Technip said. It has designed and built two similar plants in western Europe using the Amoco technology.
